default/30764.htm.text: Balthazar: How is it going? My name is Maestro Balthazar! I'm a merchant of the Black Anvil Guild. I was a much-sought-after blacksmith in my day but now I spend all of my time studying golems. If you wish to create an item you should go and ask one of my blacksmith friends!

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30764-01.ht.text: Balthazar: Sir Athebaldt has told me that your clan would be helpful in my research. I don't have the time to repeat myself, where is the leader of your fine clan?

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30764-07a.h.text: Balthazar: As I already told you, I need 10 Spiteful Soul Energies . After defeating the Spiteful Soul Captain in the Massacre Fields, collect the energies before his body vanishes. Remember, though -- I need the Spiteful Soul Energies, not the Spiteful Souls themselves!
